propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs an AcliClient with empty credentials when JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, or JIRA_API_TOKEN are missing or whitespace-only, causing silent build followed by late API failures
Cloud adapter lacks construction-time credential validation that DC adapter has via assert_env_ready and transport guards, creating a test-parity gap

_build_jira_backend must raise BackendEnvError before AcliClient construction when any of JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN are empty/whitespace, naming every missing var and the anonymous-access consequence
_build_jira_backend must validate that JIRA_USER is an email format (contains @ with non-empty local and domain parts) and raise BackendEnvError if not
test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly must flip from asserting silent build to asserting BackendEnvError is raised, achieving parity with DC test
test_the_cloud_factory_also_asserts_conformance fixture must use a valid email for JIRA_USER to pass the credential guard and still reach the conformance assertion
